analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI rose from 49.0 to 54.9 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from 33012 to 22835, but positive crossover not yet confirmed. ADX at 14.5, trend weakening continues, below 20 indicating a non-trending phase. Closed positive for 5 consecutive days, but price pattern is sideways with a decline from the 20-day high and rise from the 5-day low. Volatility is high with ATR at 7.26%. No clear buy/sell signals, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
